# Main Branch Codex Workflow Inventory

Generated by `mb`. Do not edit by hand in business repos. This file maps Main Branch workflow surfaces to the Codex owner-loop support boundary.

Status meanings:

- `supported`: Codex can use this surface for the owner loop from deterministic `mb` facts and generated guidance.
- `pending_shared_source_migration`: Codex may plan from read-only facts, but a runtime shell should wait for a shared workflow source.
- `generated_shell_pending`: a shared source exists, but a generated Codex shell still needs implementation and smoke evidence.
- `intentionally_unsupported`: outside the current Codex owner-loop target.

Codex plugin files live under `.agents/plugins/main-branch-owner-loop/` and are listed by `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`. Register the repo first with `codex plugin marketplace add .`, then use `/plugins`.

| Workflow | Codex status | Claude Code surface | Codex surface | Codex commands | Fact commands |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Start, status, and what changed | `supported` | /mb-start, /mb-status | Codex plugin commands /mb-start and /mb-status | `/mb-start`, `/mb-status` | `mb status --json --peek`, `mb start --json` |
| Setup, update, doctor, and repair planning | `supported` | /mb-setup, /mb-update, /mb-start repair routing | Codex plugin commands /mb-setup, /mb-update, and /mb-doctor | `/mb-setup`, `/mb-update`, `/mb-doctor` | `mb --version`, `mb doctor repair --plan --json`, `mb update --check --json` |
| Think, research, decide, and codify | `supported` | /mb-think | Codex plugin command /mb-think and AGENTS.md#codex-think-route | `/mb-think` | `mb status --json --peek`, `mb start --json`, `mb doctor repair --plan`, `mb connect doctor --json`, `mb checkpoint --plan --json` |
| End, checkpoint, and save business memory | `supported` | /mb-end, mb checkpoint | Codex plugin commands /mb-end and /mb-checkpoint | `/mb-end`, `/mb-checkpoint` | `mb checkpoint --plan --json`, `mb validate --json` |
| Workflow discovery and support inventory | `supported` | /mb-help and docs | Codex plugin commands /mb-workflows and /mb-help | `/mb-workflows`, `/mb-help` | `mb workflow list --runtime codex --json` |
| Bet lifecycle | `pending_shared_source_migration` | /mb-bet | Read-only facts and business-file planning only | None | `mb status --json --peek`, `mb validate --json` |
| Ads and paid creative | `pending_shared_source_migration` | /mb-ads | Read-only planning only | None | `mb status --json --peek`, `mb connect doctor --json` |
| Organic content and newsletter planning | `pending_shared_source_migration` | /mb-organic and related playbooks | Read-only planning only | None | `mb status --json --peek` |

Codex must ask before durable writes, checkpoints, repairs, updates, migrations, provider mutation, publishing, spend, customer contact, or public issue/proposal submission.
